module: imgui development tools panel for rally, intended for the rally editor. It groups four sections: "Voicepack Tools" (generation of a voicepack skeleton and export of the recording script as HTML or TXT from the text compositors), "Pacenotes Tools" (corner detection from the driveline, pacenote generation, elevation profile with JSON export), "Traffic" (traffic exclusion zones, rallyLoop missions) and "Game Settings" (displays rallyCodriverVoicepackMRU). The module returns a constructor. The generated files go to /temp/rally/.
notes: loadCompositors walks through compositors/styles/*.lua, keeps only the modules that look like a compositor (distance, componentTypes, system tables and composite, enumerate functions) and that TextCompositor can load; they are grouped by style folder.

Files produced: /temp/rally/voicepack_<style>/ (info.json, metadata and empty audio folder), /temp/rally/beamng-voicepack-script_<fingerprint>.html or .txt, /temp/rally/elevation_profile_<timestamp>.json; the folder is opened in the explorer (Engine.Platform.exploreFolder).
generateVoicepackSkeleton first deletes the output folder if it already exists (FS:remove then FS:directoryRemove).
calculateCorners depends on editor_rallyEditor (current path, pacenotes window, snaproad): the rally editor must be open.
The corner detection parameters (lookAheadContext, straightThreshold, mergeDistanceThreshold, maxSimplifyIterations) are imgui pointers initialized with PacenoteGenerator.defaultParams.
In drawDrivelinePoints, a section's direction is compared with the strings " left" and " right" with a leading space (as written in the code); a value without a space would be drawn in gray.
onUpdate only draws the elevation and driveline points if pacenotesTools.sectionExpanded is true (field absent from init, set by draw).

C.desc: Development tools object returned by the constructor.

init.desc: Loads the compositors and initializes the state of the Pacenotes Tools sections (elevation profile, driveline points, parameters) and Traffic (zone radius 10, list of rallyLoop missions).

loadCompositors.desc: Lists the valid text compositor styles, sorts them, groups them and prepares the checked boxes and the selected style for the skeleton (the first by default).

voicepackSkeletonOutDir.desc: Output folder of the voicepack skeleton: /temp/rally/voicepack_<style with '/' replaced by '_'>.

returns.desc: Path, or empty string if no style is selected

generateVoicepackSkeleton.desc: Creates a voicepack skeleton for the selected compositor: info.json (persona, language and dialect empty, style and styleLabel), empty metadata file and audio subfolder. Then opens the folder.

selectedCompositors.desc: List of the compositors checked in the interface.

recordingCoverageEntries.desc: Merges the script entries of all checked compositors (enumerateScriptEntries), keyed by audio file name, with the list of styles and contexts; sorts the result and numbers each entry (order).

exportScriptReaderHtml.desc: Exports the co-driver's recording script as an HTML page (/temp/rally/beamng-voicepack-script_<fingerprint>.html) for the checked styles.

exportScriptReaderTxt.desc: Exports the same script as a text file (/temp/rally/beamng-voicepack-script_<fingerprint>.txt).

storeElevationProfile.desc: Stores an elevation profile and computes a summary (number of points, min and max altitudes, elevation gain, 2D distance, start and end distances, number of splits and race pathnodes).

elevationProfile.desc: Points {x, y, z, distFromStart, splitLabel, isRacePathnode}

exportElevationProfileToJson.desc: Writes the stored elevation profile and its summary to /temp/rally/elevation_profile_<timestamp>.json.

drawElevationProfilePoints.desc: Draws the elevation profile as spheres (green for normal points, red for race pathnodes) if the option is enabled.

drawGameSettings.desc: Displays the value of the rallyCodriverVoicepackMRU setting in imgui.

calculateCorners.desc: Detects corners on the points of the editor snaproad's driveline with PacenoteGenerator.detectCorners and the interface parameters, then stores the points and the result.

storeCornerDetection.desc: Stores the detected sections and corners and logs their count.

storeDrivelinePoints.desc: Copies the positions of the driveline points and enables their display.

resetCornerDetectionParams.desc: Resets the detection parameters to the values of PacenoteGenerator.defaultParams.

drawDrivelinePoints.desc: Draws the detected sections (blue for left, red for right, gray for straight) with a sphere at the start of each corner, or failing that the raw driveline in dark gray.

clearDrivelinePoints.desc: Clears the stored driveline points, sections and corners and hides their display.

drawTrafficZones.desc: Draws the traffic exclusion zones (sphere of the zone radius and small center sphere) if enabled.

refreshRallyLoopMissions.desc: Reloads the list of rallyLoop missions of the current level (preceded by "<none>") and resets the selection.

getSelectedRallyLoopId.desc: Identifier of the selected rallyLoop mission, extracted from the "Name (id)" entry of the list.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame by the editor: draws the elevation and driveline points (if the Pacenotes Tools section is expanded) and the traffic zones.

draw.desc: Draws the full imgui interface of the four sections (Voicepack Tools, Pacenotes Tools, Traffic, Game Settings).

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook called when the vehicle is put back in place; empty body (commented-out code).

isPacenotesToolsSectionExpanded.desc: Indicates whether the "Pacenotes Tools" section is expanded.
